authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13519 groups the regional sonā/sonu gold family under suvarṇa or sauvarṇa. The user selected sauvarṇa when this branch is indistinguishable. The h-initial gold forms are supported by independent s/ś > h comparisons from the same language and exact survey locality; possible intra-IA transfer remains open. Exact-locality comparanda: haṭ “seven”, ek hau “one hundred”. Their full source records are preserved in gold-h-matrix.json.
